question: Where the start saves' controller of Cyp (32, Finland's) and Wadi al Hamim (5554, Britain's) at 1941.12.11 comes from, where the history gives the Soviet Union and Italy and no unit stands in either; read the middle of RunHourlyProvincePass, the (1, 1, 1) caller of Province_SetController the record had as not read

addresses.name: RunHourlyProvincePass
addresses.revises: comment and confidence: the middle of the body (0x49E664-0x49EA42), recorded as seen in the decompiler only and not read, read on the listing - an owned province in no real area handed to the enemy around it, Province_SetController(..., 1, 1, 1); confidence inferred -> confirmed
addresses.comment:
**The province's hourly work, and the only thing that adds to a faction's Progress.** 0x49E600 to the `ret 4` at 0x49EAAC (a second `ret 4` at 0x49EA93 is an exit of the same frame); RunDailyProvincePass starts after one int3 at 0x49EAB0. One caller, RunHourlyPass at 0x682A75, in a loop over every province of the game state's vector whose template's `simulated` byte (+0xD4 -> +0x13D) is set; the function tests the byte again itself.

Its head, read on the listing:

    controller = CCountryTag::GetCountry(&province->controller (+0x334))
    controller->faction (+0xD8)->Progress (+0xAC) += province->victory_points (+0x34) * 1000
    controller->+0x11CC                         += province->victory_points * 1000

So Progress is the victory points of the provinces the faction's members **control** - not own, not cores - credited to whatever faction the controller is in at that hour; a controller in no faction credits the shared null faction.

**Its middle, read on the listing 2026-11-16 (0x49E664-0x49EA42): land in no area handed to the enemy around it.** Only for an owned province (`owner_id +0x330 != 0`) whose area (+0x2B4) is the CNullOwnerArea (slot 0 false) - one level of infrastructure or none. With C = the controller's country:

    candidate = ---; friendly = 0; land = 0; vec = []          ; vec: land neighbours in no area
    for each edge of the template (+0x90..+0x94, 0x14 bytes) in order:
        if edge.kind == 3 (impassable): continue
        N = state->provinces (+0xB8C)[edge.to]
        if !N.template->is_land (+0x22): continue
        land++
        if N.area slot 0:                                     ; a real area
            if CCountry::CanOperateIn(C, &N.controller): friendly = 1; break
            if !CCountry::IsEnemyTag(C, &N.controller): continue
            if C.id (+0xCA8) == REB: continue
            candidate = N.controller                          ; the LAST such neighbour
        else vec.push(N)
    if vec.size != land:                                      ; some land neighbour in a real area
        if friendly: done
    else:                                                     ; none
        first = land ? vec[0].controller : ---
        for N in vec:
            T = N.controller
            if T.id != 0 and T != REB:
                if CCountry::IsSameSide(C, &T): done          ; no change
                if C.diplomacy (+0xE28)[T.id]->co_belligerent (+0x58) and !IsEnemyTag(C, &T): done
            if IsEnemyTag(C, &T):
                candidate = T
                if T.id != first.id: candidate = ---; break
    if candidate.id != 0: Province_SetController(province, &candidate, &state->tick (+0xBDC), 1, 1, 1)

- consequences, area rebuild, peaceful: no building damage, no zeroed production, no capital loot; the CControllerChange it logs at the tick is the `history = { <tick> = { controller = ... } }` block a save writes for the province. Being of the hour, it runs in a new game's one hour before its first screen. Measured on the start saves: it gives every one of the 15 controllers the history does not - Cyp (32) Finland's at 1941.12.11, 1943.2.1 and 1944.6.20 (beside Finland's Pecenga and Finland-held Titovka, two levels each), Wadi al Hamim (5554) Britain's at 1941.12.11 (beside Britain-held Bahi, two levels; its four Italian neighbours one level), four Algerian provinces Germany's, Daraj (9307) Italy's again and Apamama (10637, its one land neighbour across a strait) Japan's at 1943.2.1, Munda and Buala Japan's and three of New Guinea the United States' at 1944.6.20 - each with that history block, and no other province's controller moves at any of the eight start dates. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-laterstart.md, section 20.

**Its tail, read on the listing 2026-10-14** (0x49EA59-0x49EAAC): it walks the province's buildings (+0x310..+0x314) and, at the first whose `changed` byte (+0x28) is set, calls RebuildProvinceModifierValues once and returns - which clears every building's byte (FINDINGS-occupation.md section A.7). So a province one of whose buildings a bombing, a fallen-back defender's damage or the day's repair moved has its modifier made again within the hour.
addresses.evidence: disasm 0x49E600..0x49EAAC (scripts/disasm.py 0x49E600 0x4B0). 0x49E664 cmp [ebx+0x330],0; 0x49E671..0x49E67F [ebx+0x2b4] slot 0, jne past. 0x49E6A8..0x49E6CB edge count = (+0x94 - +0x90)/0x14. Loop 0x49E700..0x49E8B3: cmp [edge],3 je skip; [state+0xB8C][edge+4]; [N+0xd4]+0x22 je skip; inc [ebp-0x1c]; N area slot 0 je push (0x49E851..0x49E8A3, an inlined vector push_back); else 0x4EFA00 (CanOperateIn, ecx = C, esi = &N.controller) jne 0x49E8BB (flag [ebp-0x11]=1, leave the loop); 0x42F1B0 (IsEnemyTag) je skip; GetTag('REB') vs [C+0xCA8] je skip; candidate [ebp-0x38..-0x34] = N.controller. 0x49E8BF: vec size vs [ebp-0x1c], jne 0x49E99E (flag set -> 0x49EA42, else 0x49E9A8). Branch 0x49E8D5..0x49E988: first = [vec[0]+0x334] or ---; per N: +0x338 == 0 or 'REB' bytes -> 0x49E965; 0x4EF940 (IsSameSide, ecx C, eax &T) jne 0x49EA42; [C+0xE28][T.id]+0x58 == 0 -> 0x49E968; else 0x42F1B0 je 0x49EA42; 0x49E968 0x42F1B0 je next; candidate = T; T.id != first.id -> candidate = --- (0x49E98A). 0x49E9A8 cmp [ebp-0x34],0 je skip; 0x49EA2B..0x49EA3D push 1,1,1, &state+0xBDC, &candidate, province; call 0x4A2400. Positive control: OpenHOI3 built to this reading gives, with nothing else changed, every province's owner and controller of all eight start saves (1936.1.1 to 1944.6.20; OpenHOI3.SaveCheck write <install> new <save>, 2026-11-16) - before it, 32 and 5554 at 1941.12.11, seven at 1943.2.1 and six at 1944.6.20 differed - and those 15 are exactly the provinces whose save writes a history block dated at the start hour, other than the ones a first-hour capture or the day's return explains (5995, 5996, 6089, 6100, 6347, 10664 at 1941.12.11; China's 144 and 130 at 1939 and 1940). What would show it wrong: a later save in which an owned infra-one province beside an enemy's area and no friend's keeps its controller over an hour at war, or one handed over beside a friend's area.
